videos.caption: The 2001 NBA All-Star Game was absolutely LOADED. 🔥🍿 Allen Iverson. Kobe Bryant. Vince Carter. Tracy McGrady. Kevin Garnett. Tim Duncan. Shaq. Jason Kidd. Ray Allen. Chris Webber. Just ridiculous talent everywhere. Played in Washington, D.C., this game became an instant classic because it wasn't just highlights and dunks—the ending got SERIOUS. The West entered the fourth quarter with a 19-point lead, but Allen Iverson refused to let the East disappear. AI erupted for 15 points in the fourth, repeatedly attacking and hitting huge shots as the East stormed back. The final minutes felt more like a playoff game than an exhibition. 😤 Iverson finished with 25 points, 5 assists and 4 steals, leading the East to an incredible 111-110 comeback victory and earning All-Star Game MVP. Kobe Bryant nearly stole it for the West, finishing with 19 points, 7 assists and 4 rebounds, while Stephon Marbury drilled two massive late threes during the East's comeback. And the names on the court make the footage even crazier today. Kobe and AI. Vince and T-Mac. KG and Duncan. Ray Allen, Jason Kidd, Chris Webber, Gary Payton, Dikembe Mutombo and more. This was also just months before Iverson's 76ers and Kobe's Lakers met in the 2001 NBA Finals, making their All-Star battle even more iconic in hindsight. The stars competed. The crowd was electric. The fourth quarter actually mattered. And AI walked away with the MVP. 2001 NBA basketball was SPECIAL. 🥶🔥 #NBAAllStar #NBAAllStarGame #2001AllStarGame #2001NBA #AllenIverson #Iverson #AI #KobeBryant #Kobe #BlackMamba #VinceCarter #TracyMcGrady #TMac #KevinGarnett #TimDuncan #Shaq #ShaquilleONeal #RayAllen #JasonKidd #ChrisWebber #GaryPayton #StephonMarbury #DikembeMutombo #NBA #NBAHighlights #NBAHistory #Basketball #BasketballHighlights #BasketballHistory #AllStarWeekend #AllStarHighlights #AllStarMVP #NBAThrowback #ThrowbackNBA #ThrowbackBasketball #2000sNBA #OldSchoolNBA #BasketballLegends #NBALegends #PrimeIverson #PrimeKobe #Vinsanity #EastVsWest #FourthQuarter #ComebackWin #ClassicNBA #Hoops #BasketballTikTok #SportsTikTok #NBAEdits
